description:
Jiwoo, a college student, has a problem: whenever she tries to have sex with her partner, she always fails right “before penetration.” The cause is Geureung, a virgin ghost attached to Jiwoo. Because Geureung has driven away her lovers one after another, Jiwoo ends up breaking up with her seventh partner as well. However, when wine splashes onto a talisman meant to drive Geureung away, Geureung becomes a human with a physical body. According to the shaman, Geureung was born from his intense feelings for Jiwoo, and if things continue this way, he will become an evil spirit. There is only one condition for him to pass on peacefully: “losing his virginity with a virgin.” A female college student who wants to love with both body and heart, and a devoted virgin ghost who will disappear if he falls in love. This is a chaotic cohabitation romantic comedy between two people swept around by fate.
